acceptance_requirement: Every material slot references existing first-party texture assets or documented quarantined external dependency
reject_if: Any unresolved GUID remains in albedo normal mask detail skybox or wetness slot
proof_artifact: Material YAML scan plus Unity import proof

acceptance_requirement: Albedo normal MRAO detail emission/wetness roles are listed with shader slot and channel meaning
reject_if: Channel order guessed from filename or old mask/gloss slot treated as ORM without review
proof_artifact: Material role table and shader channel contract
applies_to: Terrain rocks flora coral wetness hard surface

acceptance_requirement: Albedo sRGB true; normal map type and linear; masks/data linear; compressed high quality; mips enabled for world textures
reject_if: Data texture has sRGB on; normal not TextureType Normal; uncompressed runtime texture used
proof_artifact: Texture import report and validator output

acceptance_requirement: Material reads as specific wet rock terrain coral kelp sky cloud waterline metal rubber or tissue under flat and URP lighting
reject_if: Flat color noise baked lighting blurred mush primitive proxy or generic Lit/default material
proof_artifact: Albedo-only normal-only mask-channel flat-light and final URP previews

acceptance_requirement: Surface sky coast waterline and photic captures remain bright readable detailed and beautiful
reject_if: Surface is darkened crushed muddy over-fogged or used to hide weak materials
proof_artifact: Current Game View and Scene View captures

acceptance_requirement: No production prefab/scene/material route binds placeholder/proxy/default/package Lit materials unless explicitly diagnostic-only
reject_if: `*_Placeholder.mat` package/default Lit null material or proxy unlit is production-bound
applies_to: Production prefabs scenes generated runtime material routes

acceptance_requirement: Wetness changes roughness/darkening/normal/specular through authored masks or owner-published state
reject_if: Wetness is a generic glossy overlay or invalid normal refs remain
proof_artifact: Wet material preview and shoreline/waterline capture

acceptance_requirement: Triplanar material declares object/world scale projection space normal blending and LOD consistency
reject_if: Projection scale changes across LODs or albedo ref unresolved

acceptance_requirement: Legacy masks have reviewed channel order and semantic emission/roughness/AO placement
reject_if: Random emission speckles or mask channels accepted without shader contract
proof_artifact: Channel debug views plus photic capture

acceptance_requirement: Compact Middle High Ultra keep same material identity while scaling resolution detail decals and optional shader richness continuously via GlobalQualityWeight
reject_if: Binary low/high art switch or compact lane becomes flat/muddy/primitive
proof_artifact: Quality lane matrix plus captures where available

acceptance_requirement: Runtime acceptance uses current Unity captures and profiler/GC/memory/VRAM proof when render/shader route changes
reject_if: Static CSV or docs are used as visual/profiler proof
proof_artifact: VisualProof packet outside Assets; Frame Debugger/profiler if needed

acceptance_requirement: Old broken materials are fixed or proven no longer production-bound
reject_if: Broken shared material remains referenced by route prefab/scene after replacement
proof_artifact: Dependency scan with before/after material binding report
applies_to: Shared rock terrain sky placeholder replacements
